meaning: Have the past experience of doing...
mnemonicOrNote: Ta-form + ことがある indicates past life experience.
exampleJapanese: 富士山に登ったことがあります。
exampleReading: ふじさんにのぼったことがあります。
exampleRomaji: Fujisan ni nobotta koto ga arimasu.
exampleEnglish: I have climbed Mt. Fuji before.

meaning: Too much, excessive (verb stem / i-adj stem / na-adj)
mnemonicOrNote: Attach すぎる to verb mass-stem or adj stem to indicate excess.
exampleJapanese: 昨夜はお酒を飲みすぎました。
exampleReading: さくやはおさけをのみすぎました。
exampleEnglish: I drank too much sake last night.

meaning: Thinking of doing... (volitional form + と思う)
mnemonicOrNote: Volitional form + と思う expresses ongoing intention or personal plan.
exampleJapanese: 来年日本へ留学しようと思います。
exampleReading: らいねんにほんへりゅうがくしようとおもいます。
exampleRomaji: Rainen Nihon e ryuugaku shiyou to omoimasu.
exampleEnglish: I am thinking of studying abroad in Japan next year.

mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Verb [ます-stem] / Adj-stem + すぎる. Indicates excessive or undesirable degree.
exampleJapanese: 昨日お酒を飲みすぎました。
exampleEnglish: I drank too much alcohol yesterday.

japanese: 〜やすい / 〜にくい (Easy / Hard to do)
meaning: easy to do / hard to do
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Verb [ます-stem] + やすい / にくい. Describes ease or difficulty of an action.
exampleJapanese: このペンはとても書きやすいです。
exampleEnglish: This pen is very easy to write with.

meaning: passive voice (is done by / suffered from)
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Godan: a-stem + れる; Ichidan: stem + られる. Describes actions performed on subject or direct/indirect adversity.
exampleJapanese: 雨に降られて服が濡れました。
exampleEnglish: I was caught in the rain and my clothes got wet.

meaning: make someone do / let someone do
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Godan: a-stem + せる; Ichidan: stem + させる. Describes making or permitting someone to act.
exampleJapanese: 母は子供に部屋を掃除させました。
exampleEnglish: The mother made the child clean the room.

meaning: I heard that, they say that...
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Plain form + そうだ. Conveys information heard from external sources.
exampleJapanese: 明日は大雨が降るそうです。
exampleEnglish: I heard that it will rain heavily tomorrow.

mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Verb [ます-stem] / Adj-stem + そうだ. Visual conjecture based on immediate appearance.
exampleJapanese: 今にも雨が降りそうです。
exampleEnglish: It looks like it could rain at any moment.

mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Verb [た-form] + ら. General conditional for sequence of events.
exampleJapanese: 駅に着いたら電話してください。
exampleEnglish: Please call me when you arrive at the station.

japanese: 〜なら (If it is the case that...)
meaning: if it is..., in case of...
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Noun / Verb [Plain] + なら. Contextual conditional offering advice based on topic.
exampleJapanese: 京都へ行くなら秋が一番いいですよ。
exampleEnglish: If you are going to Kyoto, autumn is the best time.

mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Verb e-stem + ば. Hypothetical condition showing prerequisite.
exampleJapanese: 安ければ買いたいです。
exampleEnglish: If it is cheap, I would like to buy it.

meaning: completely finish / unfortunately end up doing
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Verb [て-form] + しまう / ちゃう. Expresses completion or regret over an unintended outcome.
exampleJapanese: 大切な財布を忘れてしまいました。
exampleEnglish: I unfortunately forgot my important wallet.
